# CANDIDATE: J_ANCHOR_VALIDATION_GATE

**Filed:** 2026-09-05  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** quality_gate  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Adding a pre-merge gate that mandates walk-forward OOS testing and real-fills validation on J's anchor days will filter out overfit candidates and ensure promoted strategies have genuine edge_capture >300 with <20% deviation from BS-sim PnL on the source-of-truth trades.

## Mechanism

The gate will execute two sub-checks for any candidate:
1. **Walk-forward OOS test:** Using a 6-month in-sample / 2-month out-of-sample rolling window (or equivalent) on the full OPRA dataset, compute edge_capture on J days. Require edge_capture >300.
2. **Real-fills validation:** Re-run the candidate on the three J winner days (4/29,5/01,5/04) and three J loser days (5/05,5/06,5/07) using realistic OPRA fills (cached real bid/ask, slippage model). Compare PnL to BS-sim baseline; require absolute deviation <20% on each day.
If either sub-check fails, the gate blocks promotion.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 contracts (OP-16 source-of-truth) requires $25K+ account; $1K paper ~= 14% headline.
2. **Sample bias:** Gate logic is new; no historical sample yet. Overfit risk mitigated by requiring OOS and real-fills.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward test not yet executed for any candidate via this gate).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real OPRA validation not yet executed).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: gate may reject a candidate that would have positive edge_capture but fails due to OOS regime shift or real-fills slippage >20%. Max blow-up scenario: gate passes a candidate that later fails in live due to unmodeled execution costs.
6. **Concentration:** Not applicable (gate does not produce P&L); if used, concentration disclosure will be part of candidate evaluation.
